findings.mechanism: The focus's negated punishment relation and exhaustive no-one scope meet 89:26's repeated negation, cognate object, and restraint image; the repeated frame turns pain and binding into parallel forms of a condition no peer can impose.
findings.reader_payoff: The final no one can be heard as distinguishing unique source and measure while the next line makes the punishment experientially fixed, not merely intense.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that no one inflicts an equal punishment. Other agents' subordinate presence is not denied; the binding facet is a supplied nominated source image and the HFT relation remains attributed. The alternative that 89:25 and 89:26 simply coordinate separate unmatched acts stays live.
